constraints.message: An Attached Unit can only take 1 Enhancement.

modifiers.value: Can only take 1 unit of Crisis Battlesuits in Starfire Cadre.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that attack targets a unit that is at its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s unit has the **^^Markerlight^^** keyword and can act as an Observer unit for another unit even if it Advanced this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 1 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time a model makes a ranged attack that targets the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
